answer: Entry tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 40-unit sybil tax to transact; the tax is the kernel of the defense, a sunk cost. An honest agent pays once and earns it back over 20 epochs, but a farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 40,000 units up front. Identical clones pile onto one flat mesa, taxed double; a sable audit trail marks each payment, and reselling a slot forfeits the tax plus a 30-unit fine. Forgery costs more than it earns.
